qs.q: A 52-year-old man with Gilbert syndrome has his hepatic bile analyzed for pigment composition following a loading test. What is the typical proportion of the monosaccharide-conjugated bilirubin derivative formed by normal hepatocytes?
qs.e: Hepatocytes conjugate bilirubin into roughly 20 percent monoglucuronide and 80 percent diglucuronide. Choosing the 80 percent option incorrectly selects the fraction belonging to the diglucuronide product.
